items.item: `Sources/Git/Git.Client.Probe.swift`: with `--exit-code`, a remote that lacks the ref makes `ls-r
items.reason: probe lives in Sources/Git/Git.Client.swift. It now runs through result(_:), maps exit 2 to .missing(ref), keeps .command for other failures. Confirmed locally that git ls-remote --refs --exit-code on an empty bare repo exits 2. Test probes an empty bare repository.

notes: Behaviour change only: callers that matched .command for a missing ref now get .missing.
